plainText:
Darren Dunstan is an American-based Canadian voice actor and was also a voice director for the 4Kids Entertainment English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with DDO Artists Agency.

==Biography==
Originally from Toronto, Canada, Dunstan is now based in New York. He has voiced characters in a number of anime series, including Pokémon, and has had acting roles on stage. He played in Pokémon Live!.

Dunstan joined the around the end of Pokémon: Master Quest, once 4Kids moved the dubbing of the series from TAJ Productions to their own studio, where he took over as voice director for the series. He also was the voice director for the Destiny Deoxys during this period. He remained in this role until obtained dubbing rights to the series. He has made small appearances as a voice actor since then, most notably as Stephan.
